items.title: 1 Mega-Cap Stock to Research Further and 2 We Find Risky
items.summary: Megacap stocks dominate their sectors and their actions influence economies worldwide. The flip side though is that their sheer size means they have less room for explosive growth as scale works against them.

items.title: Steve Eisman Just Highlighted a Major Risk for the AI Boom — And It Doesn’t Appear to Bode Well for Nvidia

items.title: Alphabet, Meta, and Microsoft Are Hiding $3 Trillion in Debt On the AI Boom’s Hidden Ledger
items.summary: Every bull market eventually asks investors to squint past a number they’d rather not look at. In 2000, it was cash burn rates at dot-coms with no revenue. In 2008, it was mortgage-backed securities nobody could quite value. Today, it’s the financing behind the AI buildout — and specifically, how much of it never shows ... items.title: AI Is Driving Up Treasury Yields: ‘It Just Touches Everything’
items.summary: An age-old economics tenet posits that excessive government borrowing can leave little room for companies to tap financial markets and drive up their interest rates to punishing levels. It’s called the “crowding out” theory.
